caption: Three Bolt rides a month I swore I wouldn't take. What's your 'only when it's dark' expense?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R8 200
p/m salary
Living in Nongoma
slides.body:
Female, 27
Single, one son (4)
Job: Cashier at a hardware store
Net salary: R8 200 p/m

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Mealie meal, chicken feet, eggs, nappies, his Nestum
slides.body: I buy in bulk on the 25th and by the 20th of the next month it's tins and pap.

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: Room and kitchen in a family yard, water included
slides.body: The landlord is my cousin's friend. That's the only reason it's not R2 400.

slides.title: Black tax
slides.includes: My mother's electricity, my brother's school shoes
slides.body: I sent it the same day I got paid. If I wait I start doing sums and then I send less.

slides.title: Transport
slides.includes: Taxi to work and back, plus three Bolt rides home
slides.body: The Bolt rides are R240 a month. I told myself I'd stop after the first one. I did not.

slides.title: Crèche
slides.includes: Fees, a lunch tin, a Friday R20 for the ice cream lady
slides.body: He's four and he already negotiates the ice cream money.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Prepaid electricity, data & airtime, funeral policy, stokvel, hair
slides.body: Five small ones. None of them feel like a decision, which is how they get away with R1 400.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R8 200. That's R5 a day, so don't ask me about the 31st.

slides.title: I wanted to see it in rands
slides.body:
I uploaded my last three statements to Beyond Horizon and it sorted every transaction into categories.

The Bolt rides were the shock.

No bank login needed.
